newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Lighting Tech buys supply maker.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Lighting Tech buys supply maker.

text.p: Advanced Lighting Technologies Inc said Tuesday that it has signed a non-binding letter of intent to purchase Ballastronix Inc, a manufacturer of electromagnetic power supplies for metal halide lighting systems, for an undisclosed combination of cash and Advanced Lighting common stock.
Ballastronix, based in Nova Scotia, Canada has annual sales of over US$16 million.
Advanced Lighting said it expects the transaction to be completed in January of 1997.
